# Keweenaw Saunas (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Wood-burning barrel saunas and square saunas built in Chassell, Michigan, in the Upper Peninsula, USA.

This is a free concept page, not the official site. Official site: https://keweenawsaunas.com

## Facts (from keweenawsaunas.com)
- Address: 37055 US, Chassell, MI 49916. Phone: (906) 481-3000.
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9 to 4, weekends by appointment.
- Products: Keweenaw barrel saunas (wood-burning), square saunas, hot tubs named in the page title.
- Prices: not published on the pages reviewed.

## How to reach them
- Call (906) 481-3000 or email tammy.waisanen@icloud.com (published on their contact page). No contact form.

## FAQ
- Where? Chassell, Michigan 49916.
